verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs say users can provide their own RDF/OWL ontology, which acts as a reference vocabulary that links extracted entity types (classes) and individuals to canonical domain concepts. This is a first-party way to steer the memory schema toward a domain. It is only a linking vocabulary: nothing shows users can define custom entity types or edge types in the extraction schema, or that the ontology constrains relationships. missing for 10: custom entity-type definitions, custom edge/relationship types, evidence that the ontology constrains rather than only links extraction, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can customize the memory schema — entity types, edge types, or ontology — to match my domain

citations.quote: An ontology is an optional RDF/OWL file you can provide to Cognee. It acts as a reference vocabulary, making sure that entity types ("classes") and entity mentions ("individuals") extracted from your data are linked to canonical, well-defined concepts.
